simple.summary: טִבְחַת (Ṭibchath) means Tibchath , a place in Syria First listed occurrence: 1Chr 18 8.

definitions.full: H2880. Tibchath טִבְחַת proper name, of a location a Syrian city ; מִטִּבְחַת 1Chr 18:8 ( ᵐ5 Μεταβηχα ( ς ), ᵐ5 L ταβααθ ); so read also for II. בֶּטַח 2Sam 8:8 (see above)
